integrity: General Haar and quaternion methods are credited to prior literature. Exact standalone symbolic checks support the new analytical proof; independent mathematical assessment has not been performed.

title: Sharp fourth moments and two distinct minimizer geometries for real matrix coefficients of \(\mathrm{SO}(4)\)
